conclusions: The prior phrase three WCCMMUD input callback bodies is narrowed: only 0x00405104 is the normal active command gateway.
MajorMUD adds a second FIFO command interception layer after Worldgroup global callbacks and before its deeper parser.
State 4 performs entry initialization and state 5 performs transition cleanup; neither should be modeled as a player command parser.
Textblock and remoteaction remain downstream of the parser continuation and are not claimed closed by this pass.
